name: Player profile runtime
content:
<%_ const player = getvar('albinaPlayerProfileV1', { defaults: {} }); const worldbook = getvar('albinaWorldbookSelectionV1', { presetId: 'canonicalCore', packageIds: [] }); _%>
<player_profile>
name: <%= player.name || '{{user}}' %>
address: <%= player.addressName || player.name || '{{user}}' %>
gender_expression: <%= player.gender || 'adult male' %>
appearance: <%= player.appearance || 'fixed adult male protagonist design' %>
background: <%= player.background || 'not yet specified' %>
ability_tendency: <%= player.ability || 'observation and restraint' %>
initial_relationship_tendency: <%= player.initialRelationship || 'cautious observation; establish trust only through explicit actions' %>
content_boundaries: <%= player.boundaries || 'respect explicit consent and withdrawal' %>
route_preference: <%= player.routePreference || 'white_canvas' %>
worldbook_preset: <%= worldbook.presetId || 'canonicalCore' %>
worldbook_packages: <%= (worldbook.packageIds || []).join(', ') %>
</player_profile>
Treat this profile and selected worldbook package set as AU/IF player-authored context. Preserve player agency; do not invent unprovided actions, thoughts, or dialogue, and do not present it as Limbus Company canon.
